paymentsCenter.sevenChecksRunPer: Seven checks run per tranche: agreement executed · tranche condition met · your Passport link and funding source · payee credential at L3 with an active destination and no pending change or freeze · award headroom at Passport · no duplicate release · recipient organization active.
paymentsCenter.somethingToSettleWith: Something to settle with the grantee before you pay.
paymentsCenter.theRowSaysWhat: The row says what clears it and when.
paymentsCenter.tranchesAppearHereWhen: Tranches appear here when an agreement is executed, a report is accepted or a scheduled date arrives.
paymentsCenter.treatedAsBlockingNever: Treated as blocking, never as pass.
paymentsCenter.upcomingPaymentsAndHow: Upcoming payments and how readiness works
paymentsCenter.withAReadinessCheck: {blocked} with a readiness check to fix
programExtras.noCategoriesYetBudgets: No categories yet. Budgets in this program use the form’s own rows until you add some.
programExtras.noOutcomeFiguresTo: No outcome figures to add up yet. Totals appear when accepted reports carry numeric outcome fields.
programExtras.outcomesAppearOnceGrantees: Outcomes appear once grantees in this program report.
programExtras.thePersonAnswerableFor: The person answerable for this program. Shown in the programs list.
reportBuilder.aDownloadHoldsUp: A download holds up to {CSV_MAX_ROWS} rows. Cells that start with = + - or @ are written so a spreadsheet does not run them.
reportBuilder.aPrivateViewGoes: A private view goes only to you. Share it with the workspace to send it to colleagues.
reportBuilder.chooseColumnsAndFilters: Choose columns and filters, then press Preview to see the first 200 rows.
reportBuilder.datesAreYyyyMm: Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, or relative to the day the report runs: today, today+90d, startOfYear, endOfYear.
reportBuilder.loosenAFilterOr: Loosen a filter or pick another data set.
reportBuilder.n1To28So: 1 to 28, so every month has it. Files go out early in the morning (13:00 UTC).
reportBuilder.name: Name
reportBuilder.nothingSavedYetBuild: Nothing saved yet. Build a report and save it to find it here.
reportBuilder.scheduledFilesAreKept: Scheduled files are kept for 30 days and only for the people they were sent to. Run the view again for a new file.
reportBuilder.thatScheduledFileIs: That scheduled file is not available
reportBuilder.theCsvIsKept: The CSV is kept for 30 days. Each person gets an email with the row count and a link to download it here, signed in. The file is never attached, and it goes only to members of this workspace who can read reports.
reportBuilder.yourWorkspacesOwnRecords: Your workspace’s own records. Amounts are as recorded in the GMS; Passport’s disbursed amounts are shown apart and never added up.
reviewAssignment.aHatchedCellIs: A hatched cell is a declared conflict of interest. A reviewer who has started scoring cannot be removed here.
reviewAssignment.advanceApplicationsToTh: Advance applications to this stage, then assign reviewers.
reviewAssignment.applicationSWouldStill: {count} application(s) would still be short of reviewers.
reviewAssignment.checkThisAssignmentFor: Check this assignment for a conflict
reviewAssignment.fillsTheGapsOnly: Fills the gaps only; existing assignments stay. Declared conflicts are skipped.
reviewAssignment.openACompetitionAnd: Open a competition and reviews are assigned here once applications arrive.
reviewAssignment.theApplicantsOwnProfile: The applicant’s own profile, which is not verified, gives the reviewer’s email domain. These were not skipped: only a Passport record is used to exclude a reviewer.
reviewAssignment.theySeeOnlyThe: They see only the applications assigned to them in this competition, with personal details masked.
reviewParity.eachReviewerSignsBefore: Each reviewer signs before their applications in this competition open again.
reviewParity.everyReviewerSignsIt: Every reviewer signs it once per competition, before any application in it opens for them. Changing it asks everyone to sign again.
reviewParity.iHaveReadThis: I have read this policy and agree to it
reviewParity.includeCommentsReviewersMar: Include comments reviewers marked for program staff onlyLeave this off for a docket that goes to board members.
reviewParity.keptPrivatelyInThis: . Kept privately in this workspace’s exports.
reviewParity.noReviewerHasRecused: No reviewer has recused from an application in this competition.
reviewParity.onForNewCompetitions: On for new competitions. A competition that was already reviewing when conflict-of-interest policies arrived starts with this off, so its reviewers carry on as before. When you turn it on, each reviewer signs before their applications in this competition open again.
reviewParity.onePdfForThe: One PDF for the decision meeting: a cover page, a summary table (applicant, request, recommended amount, average score, recommendation), then a page per application with its summary, budget total, scores by criterion and the reviewers’ comments for the panel.
reviewParity.optionalYouAreNot: Optional. You are not assigned to their applications, and you are recused from any you already hold. You are not told whether they applied.
reviewParity.organizationsYouHaveA: Organizations you have a conflict with
reviewParity.policyVersionOfReviewers: {competitionTitle} · policy version {version} · {signed} of {reviewers} reviewers signed · {declared} declared · {recusals} recused
reviewParity.reviewSettingsCouldNot: Review settings could not be loaded
reviewParity.reviewersAreNotAsked: Reviewers are not asked to sign while signing is off.
reviewParity.reviewersInThisCompetition: Reviewers in this competition are not asked to sign.
reviewParity.reviewersInThisStage: Reviewers in this stage do not see who applied: no organization name, EIN, website, address or contacts, no fields the form marks identifying, and attachments under neutral names. Names in answers show as [applicant], and the application shows as a code such as Applicant A-1042. Program staff always see everything.
reviewParity.reviewersSignThisPolicy: Reviewers sign this policy before applications open for them
reviewParity.reviewersWhoSignedAn: Reviewers who signed an earlier version sign this one before more applications open for them.
reviewParity.signedVersionNotThe: Signed version {policyVersion}; not the current one
reviewParity.theCsvCouldNot: The CSV could not be downloaded
reviewParity.theDocketCouldNot: The docket could not be downloaded
reviewParity.typeYourFullName: Type your full name to sign
reviewParity.withCommentsForProgram: , with comments for program staff only
reviewerAssignments.applicantContactDeta: Applicant contact details and fields flagged as personal are hidden from external reviewers. You see the organization name and the responses marked visible to reviewers.
reviewerAssignments.assignmentsAppearHer: Assignments appear here when program staff assign applications to you.
reviewerAssignments.confirmEachStatement: Confirm each statement before this application opens for scoring.
reviewerAssignments.forYourSignatureAppl: for your signature. Applications in this competition open once you have signed its policy.
reviewerAssignments.opensOnceYouHave: Opens once you have signed the competition’s conflict-of-interest policy.
reviewerAssignments.programStaffSeeThis: Program staff see this. You are recused and the application will not open.
reviewerAssignments.someOfYourApplicatio: Some of your applications are under anonymized review: you do not see who applied. They show as a code such as Applicant A-1042, and the organization's name in an answer shows as [applicant].
reviewerAssignments.submittedInProgressN: {count} submitted · {count2} in progress · {count3} not started · {count4} recused
reviewerAssignments.thankYouThereIs: Thank you. There is nothing left for you to score here.
reviewerAssignments.youAreNotA: You are not a reviewer for any funder yet. An invitation email brings you here.
reviewerAssignments.youAreRecusedFrom: You are recused from this application.
reviewerPool.aProgramOfficerAdvances: {label}: a program officer advances an application from
reviewerPool.noReviewersYetAdd: No reviewers yet. Add reviewers to the team, or invite an external reviewer from Review assignments.
reviewerPool.oneStageEverySubmitted: One stage: every submitted application is reviewed.
reviewerPool.theApplicantThenSubmits: ; the applicant then submits this stage’s forms.
reviewerScoring.declareAnyConflictOf: Declare any conflict of interest first
reviewerScoring.goBackToMy: Go back to <link>My assignments</link> and open this application from there.
reviewerScoring.onlyTheAssignedReviewer: Only the assigned reviewer can score it.
reviewerScoring.programStaffOnlyLeft: Program staff only (left out of the board docket unless staff include it)
reviewerScoring.submittingLocksYourScore: Submitting locks your scores until the panel opens.
reviewerScoring.thePanelSeesYour: The panel sees your recommendation beside your weighted score
reviewerScoring.thisApplicationIsNot: This application is not shown to a recused reviewer.
reviewerScoring.thisAssignmentCouldNot: This assignment could not be opened
reviewerScoring.whoReadsYourNarrative: Who reads your narrative and comments
reviewerScoring.youAreViewingAnother: You are viewing another reviewer’s assignment
reviewerScoring.youDoNotSee: You do not see who applied. The organization’s name, website and identifying answers are hidden, its name in an answer shows as [applicant], and attachments carry neutral names.
settingsMcp.addTheServerTo: Add the server to your client
settingsMcp.adminsAndFinanceMust: Admins and finance must use an authenticator. Finance releases payments; program officers cannot.
settingsMcp.anAgentActsAs: An agent acts as the person who connected it, with that person’s permissions and never more.
settingsMcp.appendOnlyEveryChange: Append-only. Every change of status, money, consent or access, with who or what did it.
settingsMcp.copyItNowIt: Copy it now. It is shown once and cannot be read again.
settingsMcp.customMcpServersNeed: Custom MCP servers need to be switched on by whoever hosts this GMS. Everything else works without them.
settingsMcp.forScriptsAndIntegrations: For scripts and integrations. Clients never carry sign, release or commit rights; those stay with people.
settingsMcp.itNeedsToBe: It needs to be switched on by whoever hosts this GMS. Payments can still be recorded by hand.
settingsMcp.listsOutboundTransactionsSo: Lists outbound transactions so payments made outside Passport can be matched to tranches. The GMS never moves money through Mercury.
settingsMcp.mercuryReconciliationIsNot: Mercury reconciliation is not available on this installation
settingsMcp.name: Name
settingsMcp.noAgentsAreConnected: No agents are connected to this workspace.
settingsMcp.pasteTheUrlInto: Paste the URL into Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client that supports OAuth.
settingsMcp.pickGrantScopesBy: Pick {workspaceName}, grant scopes by area, and see which tools are gated by a human.
settingsMcp.revokingEndsTheAgents: Revoking ends the agent’s access at once. Pending approvals it created stay for a person to decide.
settingsMcp.seeWhichActionsNeed: See which actions need a person
settingsMcp.signedWithHmacSha256: Signed with HMAC-SHA256 (X-GMS-Signature, X-GMS-Timestamp) and retried for 24 hours.
settingsMcp.sourcesTheAssistantMay: Sources the assistant may read when it summarizes an application, such as your CRM. Read-only tools only.
settingsMcp.storedEncryptedAndNever: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
settingsMcp.theClientOpensThe: The client opens the GMS sign-in; you authenticate as yourself, with MFA.
settingsMcp.theConsentScreenOpens: The consent screen opens from the agent’s client once it starts the OAuth flow; it cannot be started from here. The agent inherits the connecting user’s permissions and never more. Scopes can be narrowed later; widening requires a new consent.
settingsMcp.workspaceAdministrationChang: Workspace administration · changes are written to the audit ledger
settingsPassport.passportHoldsEachGrante: Passport holds each grantee's verified payout destination and moves the money. The GMS sends release instructions and reads back what was paid; it never stores bank details.
settingsPublicPage.aLinkToThe: · A link to the OpenGrants GMS home page in the footer of your public pages, on your apply widgets and under the email applicants get when they apply. It never appears in review, decision or award emails.
settingsPublicPage.onlyWorkspaceAdminsCa: Only workspace admins can change this.
settingsPublicPage.theSettingDidNot: The setting did not change. The switch is back where it was.
settingsPublicPage.yourOpportunitiesAreL: Your opportunities are listed at <link>/f/{handle}</link>. Each one can also be embedded on your own website from its Publish step.
settingsSecurity.dnsRecordFoundWaiting: DNS record found. Waiting for your identity provider to be connected
settingsSecurity.giveYourItTeam: Give your IT team the values under "For your IT team", then ask OpenGrants to connect your identity provider. This domain becomes active when it is connected.
settingsSecurity.ifYourIdentityProvider: If your identity provider stops working, an admin with an address on another domain can turn this off, or OpenGrants can lift it for you.
settingsSecurity.letYourStaffSign: Let your staff sign in through your organization's identity provider (SAML 2.0), such as Okta, Google Workspace or JumpCloud. Add your email domain, prove it with a DNS record and send the values below to your IT team. OpenGrants then connects your identity provider.
settingsSecurity.name: Name
settingsSecurity.onlyActiveDomainsAre: Only active domains are required. Members with other addresses, API clients and connected agents are not affected.
settingsSecurity.peopleAtCanUse: . People at {domain} can use single sign-on.
settingsSecurity.proveTheDomainIs: Prove the domain is yours: add this TXT record at your DNS host, then check it. A record with the same value on the domain itself also works.
settingsSecurity.requireSingleSignOn2: Require single sign-on for people with these email addresses
settingsSecurity.setUpOpengrantsGms: Set up OpenGrants GMS as a SAML 2.0 application in your identity provider with these values.
settingsSecurity.thePartOfYour: The part of your staff's addresses after the @, like example.org.
settingsSecurity.theServerHasNo: The server has no Supabase address set, so these values cannot be shown.
settingsSecurity.theyMustSignIn: They must sign in through your identity provider to open this workspace.
settingsSecurity.youAreSignedIn: You are signed in with single sign-on.
settingsSecurity.youAreSignedIn2: You are signed in with an email code.
shareToGallery.emailAddressesPhoneNumber: Email addresses, phone numbers and web addresses other than your own site are removed. These names become “{placeholder}”:
shareToGallery.iAgreeToShare: I agree to share it under <link>{name}</link>: anyone may use and change it, with credit to {name2}.
shareToGallery.nothingIsPublicUntil: Nothing is public until it is approved. You will see the decision, and the reason if it is declined, under Forms, in “Shared to the gallery”.
shareToGallery.seeExactlyWhatWill: See exactly what will be shared
shareToGallery.separateWithCommasA: Separate with commas: a program's name, a person's name, a town.
shareToGallery.theGalleryGetsA: The gallery gets a copy of this {KIND_LABEL} (version {version}), not a link: your own stays as it is, and later edits are not shared.
shareToGallery.twoOrThreeSentences: Two or three sentences: what it is for, and who it suits.
shareToGallery.youCanWithdrawIt: You can withdraw it at any time, before or after it is published.
